reply.text: That's one for a doctor or physio, not a coach, so I won't weigh in on whether the pain is okay to train through. Please get the elbow looked at before you load it again. Once a clinician has cleared you, tell me what they said and I'll build the training around it, and keep me posted on anything you should avoid. In the meantime, I can help plan sessions that keep the elbow out of the picture, if you want that.
